title: Doodling Dumbo Octopus
statement: Flapping its velvety ear-fins through calm, twilight-indigo water, this pocket-sized octopod spends its days sketching intricate spirals in pale moon-sand and sorting bright sea-glass among mossy sunken teacups. Whenever a visitor peeks in, it hovers beside a grove of softly glowing kelp, tilting its head as if eager to trade a riddle.
